;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Mali War]]
**Gunmen on motorbikes attack an ethnic [[Dogon people|Dogon]] village in [[Mopti Region]], [[Mali]], killing 32 villagers, according to local authorities. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mali-security/attackers-on-motorbikes-kill-32-malian-villagers-local-officials-say-idUKKBN2432R8?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Casual Dining Group]], which owns the [[Bella Italia]] and [[Café Rouge]] United Kingdom restaurant chains, collapses into administration with 1,900 immediate job losses. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-53270679 (BBC News)]  

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Hpakant jade mine disaster]]
**At least 162 miners are killed by a [[landslide]] at a [[jade trade in Myanmar|jade]] [[mining]] site in [[Hpakant]], [[Kachin State|Kachin]], [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-53260834 (BBC News)]
*A fire and explosion hit a [[Gas centrifuge|centrifuge]] production plant at a [[Enriched uranium|nuclear enrichment]] facility in [[Natanz]], [[Iran]]. No deaths or injuries are reported. [https://apnews.com/50c3e7f6445ae99def6bdc65fbce6c42 (AP)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Mexico]]
****[[Governor of New Mexico|New Mexico Governor]] [[Michelle Lujan Grisham]] announces there will be $100 fines for people and businesses that do not wear masks. [https://thehill.com/changing-america/well-being/prevention-cures/505611-new-mexico-fining-100-to-those-who-dont-wear?amp (''The Hill'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kansas]]
****[[List of governors of Kansas|Kansas Governor]] [[Laura Kelly]] issues an executive order mandating citizens wear facemasks in public and at their workplace. [https://www.usnews.com/news/politics/articles/2020-07-02/kansas-governor-orders-masks-to-be-worn-in-public-at-work (AP via ''United States News & World Report'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
****[[List of governors of Texas|Texas Governor]] [[Greg Abbott]] orders citizens must wear face coverings when in public. This follows yesterday's reported state record daily high of more than 8,000 virus cases. Those who do not comply will receive an initial warning; those who refuse will face a fine of up to $250. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-53273281 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oman]]
***[[Oman]] sees a jump of cases in a day, with 1,361 new cases and three deaths, reaching a total of 42,555 cases and 188 deaths. The Health Minister says that the country will boost its hospitals' capacity and [[intensive care unit]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-oman/oman-boosts-hospital-capacity-as-coronavirus-cases-surge-idUSKBN2431XC?il=0 (Reuters)]
*The deaths of 275 [[African elephant|elephants]] are confirmed in the [[Okavango Delta]] due to an unknown cause. Both [[poaching]] and [[anthrax]] have been ruled out by authorities. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/botswana-elephant-deaths-mystery-official-say-poaching-not-suspected-today-2020-07-02/ (CBS)]

;International relations
*[[Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[United Kingdom–Venezuela relations]]
***In a case to decide who controls a $2 billion worth of gold from the [[Central Bank of Venezuela]] stored in the [[Bank of England]], the [[High Court of Justice]] in [[London]] rules that the [[United Kingdom]] "unequivocally recognises [[Juan Guaidó|Mr. Guaidó]] as [[President of Venezuela]]", refusing to give [[Nicolás Maduro]] access to the gold. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-gold/uk-government-recognises-guaido-as-venezuelas-president-in-gold-dispute-judge-rules-idUSKBN2431FG?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-53262767 (BBC News)]
**[[United States–Venezuela relations]], [[Iran–United States relations]]
***[[United States federal judge|United States District Judge]] [[James E. Boasberg]] issues a warrant for the seizure of the more than 1.1 million barrels of gasoline in the four [[Iran]]ian tankers en route to Venezuela. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20200702-us-seeks-to-seize-gasoline-in-four-iran-tankers-bound-for-venezuela/ (Middle East Monitor)]

;Law and crime
*In a [[Europe]]-wide operation, police penetrate [[EncroChat]], a top-secret communications system used by criminals to sell drugs and plan attacks. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-53263310 (BBC News)] 
*[[Nauru]]'s President [[Lionel Aingimea]] announces tougher penalties for those convicted of [[sex offense]]s, including penalties on minors who, under the new law, will not have their age as a mitigating factor. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/420333/nauru-to-get-tough-on-sex-offenders (RNZ)]
*British [[socialite]] [[Ghislaine Maxwell]], former girlfriend of American financier and convicted sex offender [[Jeffrey Epstein]], is arrested by the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] on suspicion of grooming victims of Epstein. She has also been charged with assisting Epstein's abuse of minors by helping to recruit and groom victims known to be underage. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-53268218 (BBC News)]
*A court in [[Pakistan]] orders that the four killers of ''[[The Wall Street Journal]]''  journalist [[Daniel Pearl]] remain in jail for at least three further months. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/asia/2020/07/02/Pakistani-court-orders-killers-of-WSJ-bureau-chief-to-remain-in-jail.html (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

;Politics and elections
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]
**[[David Clark (New Zealand politician)|David Clark]] resigns as [[New Zealand]]'s [[Minister of Health (New Zealand)|Minister of Health]] after security mistakes at [[quarantine]] facilities just days after the country had been declared free of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. Clark also received strong criticism for personally breaching lockdown rules twice. [[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] had refused calls to [[dismissal (employment)|sack]] the minister. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-newzealand/new-zealands-health-minister-resigns-after-coronavirus-criticism-idUSKBN24302W?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2019–20 Hong Kong protests]]
**Prominent pro-democracy camp politician and activist [[Nathan Law]] confirms he has safely fled [[Hong Kong]], following the passage of a new [[2020 Hong Kong national security law|national security law]] by [[China]]. He did not disclose which country he had fled to.  [https://www.dw.com/en/hong-kong-activist-nathan-law-says-he-fled-city/a-54033256 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]], [[2019–20 NBA season]]
**The [[Los Angeles Clippers]] close their training facility after one of the players who is expected to play in [[Orlando, Florida|Orlando]] tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.latimes.com/sports/clippers/story/2020-07-02/clippers-close-training-facility-for-a-day-after-positive-covid-test (''Los Angeles Times'')]
